info.name: JenaValve Site API (WordPress REST) Authors API

params.name: page
params.description: One-based page of the collection to return.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Items per page. Maximum 100 — `per_page=200` is rejected with HTTP 400 `rest_invalid_param`.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a free-text string.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to objects with one or more specific slugs.

items.docs: Lists the public author profiles attached to published content — two on 2026-08-04. WordPress exposes only the public byline fields anonymously (name, slug, link, avatar); email and role are not returned without authentication.

info.name: Get a public author profile by ID

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier for the object.

items.docs: Get a public author profile by ID
